name: Aggregate-then-export
preconditions: k-anonymity / minimum cell size met; aggregates contain no personal data
residualRisk: Re-identification via small cells; mitigated by thresholds

name: Pseudonymise-then-export
solves: Group AML analytics vs China/India export limits
preconditions: Keys stay in the origin cell; re-identification only in-cell
residualRisk: Pseudonymised data may still be personal data under GDPR/PIPL, so a mechanism may still be required

name: Process in place, export results
preconditions: Compute runs in-cell; only model outputs or scores leave
residualRisk: Outputs may still contain personal data; review output schema

name: Federated query
preconditions: Query engine per cell; result policy enforced at gateway

name: In-region replica for foreign parent
solves: SEBI cloud framework with a foreign parent
preconditions: Original data stays accessible in India; copy permitted per framework

name: Restricted retention vault
preconditions: Legal retention basis recorded; access restricted; erasure scheduled at retention end
residualRisk: Must document the basis per record type

name: Approval-gated disclosure
solves: Foreign regulator or court request vs China DSL Art. 36
preconditions: Request logged; competent-authority approval obtained before export
residualRisk: Timing conflict with requesting authority; legal escalation

name: Volume-managed transfer
preconditions: Counter projection shows a breach; schedule or minimise, or file for the next route
residualRisk: Threshold rules must be confirmed with counsel

name: Synthetic/test data substitution
preconditions: Synthetic data generator validated for utility and non-identifiability
